label: predatory bacterium
definition: A trophic-ecology lifestyle in which a bacterium actively kills and consumes other bacteria for nutrients, e.g. the periplasmic predator Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus.
observations: Existing v5 parent ID and meaning; included for standalone hierarchy.

label: collective bacterial predation
definition: A predatory bacterial phenotype in which cells act in coordinated multicellular groups to kill bacterial prey and obtain nutrients from the killed cells.
observations: Coordinated group feeding; neither motility alone nor obligate cooperative benefit.
